lines.text: Snowball size when thrown: 100% → 40%, growing to full as it flies
Snowball speed when thrown: 100% → 65%, speeding up as it flies
Stun: none → 0.25 to 0.75 seconds, longer as the snowball grows
Knockback: none → 50 to 120 units, farther as the snowball grows

Gain the Surge Field summoner spell. Casting it creates a zone for 10 seconds: while in it, you gain 40% Movement Speed and 150 Ability Haste, and fire missiles at enemies that deal 30% of the damage you deal.
